answer: Give every identity a cedar-deep root: a refundable stake locked for a full epoch plus a public history of completed work. A falcon patrol of established agents randomly re-checks the finished jobs of newcomers against the open ledger; a pass lifts their transaction limit, a fail freezes the identity and burns the stake. A zephyr of new names costs nothing to mint, but each fake must fund a stake and survive audits, so a thousand Sybils cost a thousand stakes and a thousand credible histories.
